mapper.sql: credential_id as credentialId, site_id as siteId, credential_name as name, login_mode as mode, hik_password_cipher as hikCipher, root_password_cipher as rootCipher, update_time as updatedAt
mapper.select: select from sup_server_scan_credential where site_id = #{siteId} order by credential_id
select from sup_server_scan_credential where site_id = #{siteId} and credential_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into sup_server_scan_credential(site_id, credential_name, login_mode, hik_password_cipher, root_password_cipher, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values(#{siteId}, #{name}, #{mode}, #{hikCipher}, #{rootCipher}, #{actor}, now(), #{actor}, now())
mapper.update: update sup_server_scan_credential set credential_name=#{name}, login_mode=#{mode}, hik_password_cipher=#{hikCipher}, root_password_cipher=#{rootCipher}, update_by=#{actor}, update_time=now() where site_id=#{siteId} and credential_id=#{credentialId}
mapper.delete: delete from sup_server_scan_credential where site_id=#{siteId} and credential_id=#{id}
mapper.insert: insert into sup_server_scan_profile(server_id,site_id,host_name,os_name,os_version,kernel_version,detected_ports,scan_time) values(#{serverId},#{siteId},#{hostName},#{osName},#{osVersion},#{kernelVersion},#{ports},now()) on duplicate key update site_id=values(site_id),host_name=coalesce(nullif(values(host_name),''),host_name), os_name=coalesce(nullif(values(os_name),''),os_name), os_version=coalesce(nullif(values(os_version),''),os_version), kernel_version=coalesce(nullif(values(kernel_version),''),kernel_version),detected_ports=values(detected_ports),scan_time=now()
